end.parentNote: Asha practised reading x as horizontal movement and y as vertical movement, using cricket-pitch examples and step directions. Harsh correctly identified quadrants from coordinate signs and explained that (3, 2) and (2, 3) are different points. They briefly mixed up whether the two ordered pairs could match, then corrected this later by describing their different movements. At home, ask Harsh to draw a coordinate grid and plot five ordered pairs, saying each horizontal and vertical move aloud.
